description: This trail provides access to a small secluded lake that is reported to have good fishing. Agnes Lake is situated in a lodgepole pine & spruce forest in the foothills of the Coast Range of mountains at an elevation of 1300 m. The trail is only 600 m long and provides relatively easy access to Agnes Lake. Travel time is only about 15 minutes by foot. There are no facilities at the lake. The trail and surrounding area was heavily impacted by wildfire in 2017, but the trail has been rerouted to avoid some of the more heavily burned areas, and the new trail has been cleared and marked with orange trail markers.
directions: From Highway 20 approximately 24 km west of Tatla Lake, turn south onto the Miner Lake Forest Service Road and travel 11.2 km where there is a minor road taking off to the left. Turn left here and travel another 0.2 km to a parking area which is an old landing. Walk in about 600 meters to the lake.

stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - South Cariboo - Chilcotin - Central Coast

title: Agnes Lake Trail
